directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write a short essay on how to best handle the relationship between teachers and students. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
sample_essay:
Building a positive relationship between teachers and students is crucial for effective learning. To best handle this relationship, several strategies can be adopted.

To begin with, communication is the key. Teachers should actively listen to students' opinions and concerns, creating an open-door policy. For example, having regular one-on-one meetings allows students to express their difficulties freely. In addition, students should also be proactive in communicating with teachers, asking questions and seeking advice. 

Furthermore, mutual respect is essential. Teachers should respect students' individuality and learning paces, while students should respect teachers' authority and expertise. For instance, teachers can design diverse teaching methods to meet different students' needs, and students can show respect by following classroom rules. 

In conclusion, by enhancing communication and mutual respect, teachers and students can build a harmonious and productive relationship, which is beneficial for both teaching and learning.
